preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100.
The number of SWAG Traits n must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ki <= 100 for ki in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(n)])
preconditions.description: Each SWAG Trait size ki must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 1000 for x in [int(x) for _ in range(n) for x in input().split()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each element in the SWAG Traits must be a positive integer less than or equal to 1000.

postconditions.description: The output must be two space-separated integers representing the SWAG levels of RK and RG.
RK's SWAG level must be greater than or equal to RG's SWAG level when both play optimally.
Both RK's and RG's SWAG levels must be non-negative integers.
